rows.grounds: instrumental indicating the cause of affliction
past passive participle describing the affected state
ablative indicating passage or lapse of time
negative adjective describing what cannot be controlled or treated
indeclinable asserting certainty of the outcome

items.question: What certain outcome results when a disease-afflicted condition persists over time?
premises: A condition can be afflicted by disease.
Time can pass without effective intervention.
An affliction may progress beyond control.
items.inference: A disease-afflicted condition will certainly become unmanageable over time.
uncertainties: The implied subject of pīḍitaṃ and avidheyaṃ is not explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Afflicted by disease, it would certainly become unmanageable over time.
